thread:
oncall-bot: :rotating_light: paging: P0 - elevated 5xx and gateway timeouts observed for private inference-gateway (us-west-2). Started ~13:01 UTC. Symptoms: repeated 502/504 from inference gateway, client timeouts, retry storms. @lee on-call.
lee (oncall): I'm on it. looking at the console now — token error rate +18% last 15m, 99th perc latency spiking to 4s. any recent deploys or config changes?
ashwin (infra): no deploys in last 2h. infra metrics show NAT-peering-gw-2.az2 ephemeral port saturation and conntrack ~94%. seeing lots of TIME_WAIT and FIN_WAIT sockets.
maria (networking): seeing lots of SNAT collisions and retries from peering->private-nat. tcpdump shows many SYNs getting RSTs after translation failure. suspect NAT port pool exhaustion on the peering appliance.
lee (oncall): ok. can we confirm SGs or peering flaps? ops_sre, can you check BGP/peering health?
ops_sre: peering looks stable, no BGP resets. but the NAT appliance is dropping translations. also saw a rollback of an unrelated SG rule yesterday (maria?) — not likely cause for egress but worth confirming.
maria (networking): I made a small security-group tighten yesterday afternoon but it only affected ingress to metrics collectors. not egress. confirmed.
ashwin (infra): current conntrack snapshot (truncated):
```
# conntrack -S
entries: 487432
search buckets: 65536
num expected: 0
# netstat -an | grep TIME_WAIT | wc -l
214523
```
we're hitting conntrack limits and local port exhaustion. NAT appliance logs show "no available SNAT ports" errors.
lee (oncall): immediate mitigation options? we need quick reduction of 5xx customer impact.
maria (networking): options:
- shift a portion of inference egress to public-egress-backup (fast, immediate)
- increase conntrack/ip_local_port_range on appliance (requires careful tuning)
- add additional NAT IPs/pools on standby peering (provisioning takes ~10-20m)
ashwin (infra): I'll apply a conntrack bump and reduce TIME_WAIT where safe. applying now:
```
# temporary mitigation commands
sudo sysctl -w net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_max=524288
sudo sysctl -w net.ipv4.tcp_fin_timeout=30
sudo sysctl -w net.ipv4.ip_local_port_range='1024 65535'
```
(note: making this persistent will be follow-up)
deploy-bot: routing policy update queued: route 20% inference-egress -> public-egress-backup. CI checks passed. deploying now. :rocket:
lee (oncall): K. adding traffic shift and conntrack bump. monitoring dashboard: 5xx down from +18% to +6% in 7m, latency tail improving but still elevated. starting customer impact assessment.
sarah (customer-success): currently 17 unique customer error reports in the platform intake. two larger customers (AcmeCo, Globex) show increased failed requests and timeouts. status page draft prepared; waiting to confirm stabilization before pushing update.
ops_sre: suggestion: enable per-connection SNAT port reuse / port pooling on appliance to reduce collisions. coordination with vendor required — raising ticket but not immediate.
maria (networking): I'll provision 2 additional SNAT addresses on standby peering; ETA 12m. this should reduce collisions.
ashwin (infra): provisioning standby SNAT now. also removing some long-lived connections to reduce conntrack churn (debugging cron job kills for test workload).
lee (oncall): quick traffic numbers: peak requests dropped by 22% after routing shift, error budget burn reduced. moving from P0->active mitigation. still keep paging open until fully stable.
ashwin (infra): SNAT IPs attached. conntrack entries started to drop. 5xx rate trending to baseline. logs show fewer "no available SNAT ports" errors.
lee (oncall): Good. prepare handoff notes for night: Priya will take over monitoring and next steps. Priya, summary:
- Incident: NAT port exhaustion causing gateway 502/504s on private peering
- Mitigations applied: conntrack increase, TIME_WAIT tuning, 20% traffic routing to public-egress-backup, attached 2 standby SNAT IPs
- Customer impact: ~17 customers affected, two high-impact accounts (AcmeCo, Globex). CS notified and draft status page ready.
- Next actions: validate long-term SNAT scaling plan, consider rate-limiting retries at gateway, vendor follow-up for port pooling.
priya (oncall-night): taking handoff — thanks. I'll keep 30m check-ins and escalate if 5xx > 1% sustained.
lee (oncall): formal handoff at 13:27 UTC. handoff notes pinned to incident channel and runbook link: https://internal.runbooks/redwood/nat-port-exhaustion
sarah (customer-success): publishing status update now: "We are investigating elevated timeouts and intermittent errors for private inference customers in US-WEST region. Mitigations applied; monitoring shows improvement. We'll update within 1 hour." :pencil2:
ops_sre: follow-up action items assigned: vendor NAT port pooling ticket, add SNAT capacity autoscaling in runbook, add alert for conntrack >80% in peering clusters.
lee (oncall): closing active paging. keeping incident thread open for postmortem notes. thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
